routed_gaps.finding: Four of five parser sites ignore trailing bytes returned by x509-parser.
Native QUIC falls back only on UnknownIssuer, while ATP CLI falls back after any WebPKI rejection.
Native and ATP pinned fallbacks differ on EKU any and leaf KeyUsage digitalSignature policy.
rustls-webpki ignores certificate KeyUsage in standard validation; the only active leaf digitalSignature check is the native pinned fallback.
Local CA admission requires BasicConstraints CA=true but not KeyUsage keyCertSign, and strict admission is optional for direct roots.
The acceptor's server-chain date and subject preflight has no identical rustls owner and can be publicly disabled.
TlsConnector::new accepts a caller-supplied ClientConfig whose verifier may bypass all standard checks; attached pinning is additive, not a validation repair.
Live native QUIC and ATP handshake errors collapse detailed certificate causes to redacted provider codes.
The wasm TLS dependency graph contains x509-parser, but CAP-TLS-X509 names only native platforms and has no wasm TLS interoperability evidence.
No canonical dependency-sovereignty tls_x509_interop summary/events receipt exists yet.
OCSP response bytes are not validated by rustls 0.23.42; CRL policy is optional and is bypassed by an admitted exact-leaf fallback.
The root facade API map records only the preview tls module; nested certificate, connector, acceptor, pin, and QUIC identity APIs require this dedicated inventory.

no_claim_boundaries: This inventory does not implement a DER parser or change runtime behavior.
It does not prove rustls, rustls-webpki, x509-parser, ring, or any certificate corpus correct.
It does not approve either exact-leaf fallback policy; A2 must narrow and prove delegation.
It does not prove canonical DER, duplicate-extension, critical-extension, time, allocation, or depth bounds for retained residue.
It does not prove live cross-implementation TLS, QUIC, ATP, mTLS, rotation, cancellation, or shutdown.
It does not claim wasm TLS support merely because Cargo metadata contains the edge.
It does not prove performance, broad workspace health, release readiness, or live RCH fleet availability.
It does not authorize changing features, removing x509-parser, deleting files, or cutting over any capability.
